_readme: Verified intake details for Erasmus Mundus programmes. Add an entry ONLY after checking the programme's own official website. Keys are programme slugs from erasmus-mundus.json. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Leave a field null if the official page does not state it. See CONTENT-GUIDE.md.

noha.deadlineNote: Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline, 23:59 GMT. All required documents must be submitted, and applicants must have graduated, by this date.

otherDeadlines.label: Applicants without EU citizenship or an EU residence permit

emma.deadlineNote: 13:00 Central European Time. Erasmus Mundus scholarship consideration uses the same application and deadline.
emma.scholarshipNote: The programme states it has new Erasmus Mundus funding for around 10–15 scholarships per intake.

emai.deadlineNote: Deadline not yet published on the official website.

imbrsea.deadlineNote: Applications for academic year 2027–2028 open on 1 December 2026. The closing date is not stated on the official website.
imbrsea.scholarshipNote: The official funding page states: “Unfortunately, we do not have Erasmus Mundus scholarships available for the 2026-2027 academic year.” It does not yet say whether scholarships will be offered for 2027–2028.

bdma.scholarshipNote: The official website reports (news of 17 Sep 2024) that BDMA has finished its current European Commission funding. It also announces a new Erasmus Mundus programme, DEAI (Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence).
